title: On the support of admissible subcategories
summary: Let $X$ be a smooth proper variety over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let $\mathcal{A} \subset D^{b}_{\mathrm{coh}}(X)$ be an admissible subcategory. Let $Z \subset X$ be the union of set-theoretical supports of all objects in $\mathcal{A}$ and assume that $Z \neq X$. We show that for any morphism from $Z$ to an abelian variety each fiber has no isolated points; this implies, for example, that $Z$ cannot be isomorphic to an abelian variety.
